transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Well, I'm here because... I just keep forgetting things at work. I do general maintenance, and lately I keep missing scheduled callbacks and work orders. Even just basic follow-ups I promised people, they completely slip my mind. 

It's piled up so much now that my work actually sent me here. They basically told me I need to get this sorted out before I lose my shot at moving up.
When did you first start noticing these problems with forgetting things?

Well, I'd say it's been noticeably worse for about 11 months now. That's when a new management company took over. They changed our whole department over to digital work orders, and they started wanting much stricter documentation for everything we do. Ever since they made that switch, the forgetting has just been a lot more of an issue.
Looking back to when you were growing up or in school, did you have similar difficulties with focus, forgetfulness, or staying organized?

Yeah, actually. I remember being this way back in grade school, honestly, long before I had any of this pressure at work. My teachers always told my parents I was bright, but I was constantly misplacing my assignments or losing papers. I'd miss parts of the directions they gave us, and they always had to remind me to just finish the classwork that was sitting right in front of me. So, yeah, it's been an issue for a long time.
Do you often feel physically restless, fidgety, or like you have trouble sitting still?
No, not really. I don't have trouble sitting still or anything like that. I'm not bouncing off the walls or fidgeting. It's really just the focusing and remembering things that's the problem for me.
